topic: Facility data source requirements for reporting
summary_markdown: The conversation clarifies the nature of data used for bus facilities. It was established that these are aggregated zone data based on bus passage, and they do not rely on physical sensors or linked sensor data. The data is considered fully modeled. A report check was discussed to determine if a facility has an attached sensor source, a feature implemented previously to filter out newly created facilities lacking data sources.
decisions: Bus facility data is aggregated zone data and is fully modeled without physical sensors.
